item.title: Page updated: Franklin County Registry of Deeds — Franklin County Registry of Deeds
item.description:
This page's content changed since the last check. Visit the page directly to review the update.
What changed (text excerpt): Added: + Registry of Deeds + webdevfcm + 2026-05-28T10:18:15-04:00 + Registry of Deeds + Attention: The Franklin County Registry of Deeds is now offering a free fraud alert tool to help property owners receive alerts whenever a document, such as a deed or mortgage, is recorded in their name. Sign up now at + IQS fraud alert + . + Beginning January 1, 2026, the Maine Registers of Deeds Association will be using a new flat rate recording fee structure. + Click this + link + for more detailed information. + Contact Information and Office Hours + 140 Main St, Suite 5 + Farmington, Maine 04938 + Office: 207-778-5889 + Business Hours: 8:30 am – 4:00 pm + Helpful Links + How to Record a Deed + Document Margin Requirements + Recording Fees + Transfer Tax Tables + Real Estate Transfer Tax Declaration Form + Transfer Tax Exemptions + LUPC Served Areas Tax Maps + Property Fraud Alert + **NEW** + The purpose of the Registry of Deeds is to record and preserve all land records in Franklin County. The Franklin County Registry of Deeds has documents dating back to 1838 and the public has access to them all through a searchable index that contains the names of all parties related to the document. + To access and make copies of our records, the public may either visit the Registry of Deeds office in person and use our computer station, books, or registry staff + or + view and download the documents online using a personal computer.
